title: fix(types): close GSAP, WASM and declaration dependencies
head: fix/public-declaration-closure-20261009
body:
The canonical package producer omitted GSAP ambient type dependencies, emitted private WASM references through blocked self-package exports, and shipped declarations whose Vue Router/type-fest dependencies were not installed. Build-utils also imported an undeclared existing @pnpm/types dependency and failed its strict unbuild warning gate.

This branch preserves GSAP references in source declarations, rewrites internal WASM declaration references relatively, and declares existing pinned type dependencies without changing versions, runtime implementation, exports/CSP, or failure controls. It includes the frozen f452 motion-owner and 6727 quoted-reference prerequisites on main 8db0.

Validated source: 48ac5c2029a231e574a77a4aa537907f5bd447da; actual local tarball SHA256 91dbac01c30df9c9b3d9f29811a3d045244ceb65f82845fba9f23f210f391256. Canonical build/verification and frozen consumer install pass. All four standalone motion declaration probes pass under Bundler and Node16 with strict=true and skipLibCheck=false. Motion runtime: 2 selected pass, 36 outside selection; declaration-path controls 10/10, package refusal controls 9/9, build-utils controls 2/2 plus exact type-contract probe pass.

WIP: full installed-package strict check still fails 191 genuine component-source diagnostics. Root motion import check also fails 185 dependency-closure diagnostics; it is not reported as all-green. No missing dependencies, blocked WASM or GSAP diagnostics remain. Exact Input 286 is historical comparison, not a newly rerun baseline. See remaining diagnostics and source-owner handoff for 145 generic constraints, 34 duplicate emit parameters, 4 missing entries + 6 unavailable global exports, 2 JSX leaks.

Related to the DAG/issue827; does not close runtime, physical-device, browser or published-artifact acceptance. No package publication, default push or merge. Local alias remains 73a61. GitHub CI is not claimed to pass. Current UI main 8db0 has no conflict with this source head; Blog master fetched c04f6bfc. Component/shared source requires coordinator ownership assignment; TableV2 hunks are proposed for 826.

Consumer-visible changesets included; build-utils dependency-only repair is internal and needs no changeset. Rollback is reverting this isolated branch's source commits, without touching the real local alias or frozen review branches.
